description.value: Fruiticana is a South Asian-focused grocery chain founded in 1994, now one of Western Canada's largest independent grocers with over 23 locations across BC and Alberta. The store specializes in fresh fruits, vegetables, and spices, sourced both locally and internationally, with a strong emphasis on authentic flavours under its own Indican spice brand. A touring cyclist would find a well-stocked selection of fresh produce and specialty ingredients at this suburban supermarket.
